question: Write a detailed response explaining the significance of Let us read in the chapter, using the source evidence and supporting details.
answer: Day by day I float my paper boats one by one down the running stream. In big black letters I write my name on them and the name of the village where I live. I hope that someone in some strange land will find them and know who I am.
